shim_verbose.description: Sets SHIM_VERBOSE environment variable. Corresponds to --set-verbosity. Values: true, false

fallback_verbose.description: Sets FALLBACK_VERBOSE environment variable. Corresponds to --set-fallback-verbosity. Values: true, false

fallback_noreboot.description: Sets FB_NO_REBOOT environment variable. Corresponds to --set-fallback-noreboot. Values: true, false

sbat_policy.description: Sets SbatPolicy UEFI Variable. Corresponds to --set-sbat-policy. Values: latest, automatic, delete

ssp_policy.description: Sets SspPolicy UEFI Variable. Corresponds to --set-ssp-policy. Values: latest, automatic, delete

mok_timeout.description: Sets the timeout for MOK prompt in seconds. Corresponds to --timeout. Range: -1 to 32767 (0x7fff)

ignore_db.description: Tells shim to not use keys in db to verify EFI images. Corresponds to --ignore-db. Values: true, false
